title: Where the parts need help outside Markdown

entities.title: Tables in parts 5 and 6
entities.summary: Part 5's counts for the flag of England and its glossary of terms, and part 6's table of comparison against collation, are Markdown tables.
entities.impact: On a platform that strips tables they lose their meaning.
entities.workaround: Rewrite them as lists for that platform.

entities.title: Y code blocks in part 11
entities.summary: Part 11's code samples are fenced with a y language tag.
entities.impact: Syntax highlighters do not know the tag.
